lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a non-linear grid. Four primary horizontal rows are visible posterior to the fifth gill slit, with the second row from the top exhibiting the highest pixel intensity and largest cluster diameters.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible in the mid-flank region. Distinct grid-like anchor nodes are formed where these vertical bands intersect with the primary horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal carinae are visible. The primary ridge runs along the mid-lateral line, exhibiting a sharp luminance gradient with higher intensity on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge. Two secondary ridges follow parallel trajectories dorsally and ventrally.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 6-8 high-luminance blobs are visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin. These are distributed primarily along the lower half and leading edge of the fin surface.
